title: Search engines
subtitle: The search engine that your browser uses is nearly as important as the browser itself. There are a variety of options that you can choose from, and each option utilize different methods of indexing content from the web.

context.title: Things to consider
context.body: Every search you make on Google is stored, timestamped, and tied to your account or IP address. Utilizing additional tools will further improve your digital privacy.
context.body2: There are many other options available than what are listed below. If none of these work for you, check out recommendations on Privacy Guides (https://www.privacyguides.org/en/search-engines/) or Alternative To (https://alternativeto.net/software/google-search/).

warning.body: Changing your browser is an important first step, but you must update your search engine as well to get the full benefits of a privacy-focused browser.

comparisonTable.title: Search engine comparison
comparisonTable.note: You might want to try different search engines - each of them have weaknesses and strengths.

sections.label: Add the search engine to your browser

items.name: Update default search engine on iOS
items.why: Because of the way browsers work on iOS, this setting can only be changed in your iOS settings and there are limited options for setting the default browser.

steps.text: Open `Settings` → `Apps` → `Safari` → `Search Engine` → choose your preferred search engine

sources.label: Change your default search engine on iPhone - Apple

items.name: Update default search engine on Android
items.path: Change for the browser and search widget
items.why: You can update the search engine for the browser as well as the search widget on your homepage.

steps.text: Open your browser → tap on the search engine icon in the search bar → `Search settings` → `Default search engine` → choose your preferred search engine
Install a supported search engine (like DuckDuckgo) → long press the app → tap `Widgets` → save it to your home screen

sources.label: Change your default search engine & add or disable apps - Google

items.name: Add to Firefox
items.why: Firefox offers good privacy on its own, but installing a good search engine will make it even better.

items.name: Add to Brave
items.why: Brave offers excellent privacy by default, so be sure to add a quality search engine to go with it.

steps.text: Open `Menu` → `Settings` → `Search Engine` → under Normal Window click `Change` → under Private Window click `Change`

sources.label: How do I set my default search engine? - Brave
